title: Add scoped DEX transaction and trade-leg activity to the daily brief
objective: Add separate daily Dune aggregate queries and display fields for deduplicated DEX transaction count, trade-leg count, and legs per transaction for Solana, BSC, and Robinhood's declared Uniswap v2/v3/v4 scope, without changing existing capital-query versions.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized daily aggregate reporting. This task creates no real Dune query, database write, migration execution, CardKit send, Hermes call, backfill, or chain adapter action before independent audit GREEN.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute Dune queries, PostgreSQL writes, migrations, CardKit sends, Hermes, lark-cli, external providers, backfills, or chain adapters before independent audit GREEN.
Do not modify existing G1/S1/B1/R1 capital SQL or query versions; add separate activity blueprints so historical series remain version-consistent.

Do not call addresses buyers, users, wallets, smart money, or traders beyond the pinned observed DEX transaction field; do not add buy/sell, net liquidity, active-pool, Four.meme, full Robinhood, FDV/market-cap, TVL, Kline, graduation, cohort, recommendation, score, or trading claims.
Do not count raw transfer events as trade legs, claim a trade leg is a completed user swap, or compare Robinhood beyond its declared Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial coverage.
Do not print, persist, or commit Dune credentials, DATABASE_URL, Feishu target IDs, tokens, cookies, or raw provider payloads.
